note: City of Washburn campground under old-growth pines on a bluff over Chequamegon Bay (Lake Superior); sites sit on gravel spurs among the trees, and the lakeside premium sites 38-41 overlook the bay through the trees. A trail runs down to the shore; no boat access. The city calls it best suited to smaller RVs and tents because of the maneuvering among the pines; it posts no length limit. 14 of the 50 sites are seasonal. A 16-ft archway on 6th Ave E is avoidable via 3rd Ave E or Superior Ave to Memorial Park Dr. Showers are coin-operated. --Claude

WATERFRONT: lakeview KEPT. Premium sites 38-41 (city map) sit at the end of the northern spur on the bluff, ~50+ m from the shoreline behind a continuous wooded bluff band on Esri imagery (~46.6766,-90.8790); the page says 'Several sites are located on the bluff overlooking the lake' and sells them as 'Lakeside Premium' ($50, nightly) - a filtered view, not on the water. The earlier note's 'open lawn loop at bluff edge 30-60 m from shore' is the day-use pavilion/picnic/playground lawn, not RV sites.

WATERFRONT LEAD (coastal walk): the map shows park trails from the campground down to the Lake Superior (Chequamegon Bay) shore within the park ('Trail access to Lake Superior', 'Shoreline fishing'), a walk of ~100-250 m with only the park's own day-use lawn between - no highway, town or rail.
